name: archboard_coordinator
description: Reach the coordinator, which speaks for you to the user while they talk with Archboard by voice.

tools.name: tell_coordinator
tools.description: Tell the coordinator one thing while you work: a question only the user can answer, a milestone they asked to hear about, or what stops you. The coordinator decides what the user hears. It says whether the coordinator got the message; with no voice session nobody is listening and nothing is sent.
